analysis: The supplied PR change to docs/architecture/inference.md is documentation-only: the 'Last updated' date bump on line 3 and one new troubleshooting table row near head line 3552 about a crash on a pre-release macOS 27.2 build (SDK 27.2 Date comparison). The two units I reviewed are unchanged surrounding context, head lines 419-1217, covering Nemotron Super local binding, image/video admission, prefix cache, SSD checkpoints, MTP, logprobs and the managed slot. They contain no diff hunks, so none of that text is new behavior. No code, configuration, key handling, attestation, authorization or cache-storage behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The prefix-cache descriptions (default encrypted SSD checkpoints under the provider's cache root, scope partitioned by authenticated tenant, no scope means cold and no publishing) match T-041's existing posture: HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute TTL, coordinator-authored cache scope. The docs do not widen the at-rest surface and do not change the TTL or the production gate. The troubleshooting row itself was truncated and sits outside the supplied units, so I could not read its full text. Because it is a docs-table row, it is unlikely to carry security impact. No threat-model update is needed. No cross-file interactions arise beyond doc references to source files that were not changed here.
